name: timer
title: Timer
description: Named countdown timers over the `timer` CLI: the soonest one on the bar with a fill and a red alarm when it lands, the list, pause, resume and stop in the palette; a pomodoro mode that cycles work and break timers and counts the rounds.
author: pal

timer.title: Timer
timer.description: The soonest timer's remaining time with a fill; an alarm once it lands; hidden with none running. The popover: a card per timer with the time left and a bar, pause, add five minutes, stop, a field to start one, a pomodoro's phase and round on its card.

ending.title: Nearly landed, another timer behind it

always.title: No timers, kept on the bar (Always)

keys.title: Pause, resume or dismiss the timer with the ring
Move the ring to another timer (or click a card)
Start one: type 25m tea in the field, Enter
Skip to the pomodoro's next phase

store.tagline: Named countdowns and pomodoros, with an alarm on the bar
features: One row per timer, most urgent first: `3:12 left, done at 04:41 PM`, `Paused at 41:05`, `Landed 1:35 ago`, with a state tag
New timer takes its fields in the search bar: `25m`, `90s`, `1h30m` or a bare number of minutes, an optional name, and Silent or Ring the phone when it lands
`enter` pauses, resumes or dismisses; `cmd++` adds the minutes typed in the bar (five when blank); `cmd+d` stops

Pomodoro: Start Pomodoro (or `p` in the popover) runs 25 minutes of work, 5 of break, 15 after the fourth round, each as a timer of its own that the next phase follows when it lands; the bar reads `12:34 · 2/4`, the card names the phase, `cmd+s` skips a phase, `cmd+shift+d` stops the cycle, and a Pomodoros today row counts the finished rounds
The CLI keeps the timers, so one started in a terminal and one started here are the same list

A bar item with the soonest timer's countdown and a fill, blue to amber to red, an alarm once it lands; its popover a card per timer with the time left, pause, add five minutes, stop, and a field that starts one (`25m tea`)

actions.title: Pause / Resume / Dismiss
actions.description: Pause a running timer, resume a paused one, dismiss a landed one.

actions.title: Add minutes
actions.description: The minutes typed in the bar, five when blank.

actions.title: Start
actions.description: On New timer: the bar takes the duration (required), a name and Silent or Ring the phone, then the CLI starts it.

actions.title: Start pomodoro
actions.description: The Start Pomodoro row: the first work round's timer, the breaks and the next rounds follow on their own.

actions.title: Skip to the next phase
actions.description: On the pomodoro's timer: this phase's timer stopped, the next started.

actions.title: Stop pomodoro
actions.description: The cycle is over; the timer stopped.
